## St Paul Drops Experimental Vaccine Mandate
**Tuesday, October 11th, 2022** Friend, St Paul dropped its experimental vaccine mandate for city employees today after several defeats in court. Radical liberal mayor, Melvin Carter, who joined Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey and Minnesota Governor Tim Walz in instituting experimental vaccine mandates for government employees, retracted the policy today in a letter to city employees. The original mandate by Carter gave city employees up until the end of 2021 to be in compliance with the experimental vaccine schedule. But several unions representing city employees sued the Mayor. A Ramsey County Judge sided with the unions and invalidated Carter's vaccine order this summer. [](https://www.action4liberty.com/st_paul_drops_experimental_vaccine_mandate_for_city?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=st_paul_drops_experimental_vac&n=2) Despite numerous evidence that the experimental vaccines do not work on recent COVID strains, Carter and others at St Paul City Hall waited until today to voluntarily suspend the anti-freedom mandate themselves. **More importantly, Melvin Carter's mandate did not give women city employees freedom of choice over their own health care. What a bunch of hypocrites!** The Democrat talking points on abortion are in stark contrast to their actual policy of "government knows best" when it comes to an individual's health care needs. Seems like the only policy they are pro-choice on is the one that kills a human life. **Action 4 Liberty fought against the tyrannical vaccine mandates last year. And when the legislature convenes again next year, hopefully with a lot of new legislators and a new Governor, it's important we make sure it Never Happens Again!**
## **Jake Duesenberg**

Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

Fellow American,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

Please take a look: | Fellow American, For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder. I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them. But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down. We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, I'm a Christian who is saved by grace. body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601504:6fprr5VNn:m:1:3331421248:36C1156BA78B6BE146F13D5C6062A6A4:r)

Peter,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601504:6fprr5VNn:m:1:3331421248:36C1156BA78B6BE146F13D5C6062A6A4:r)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601504:6fprr5VNn:m:1:3331421248:36C1156BA78B6BE146F13D5C6062A6A4:r)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

Peter,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601840:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Peter, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601832:JjCTA5VNu:m:1:3317145305:447B6374F30EB8AE582479AF093A095D:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Peter, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

Jaime and I were just flipping through an old photo album and this one caught my eye.

**_This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he 's leading._**

Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. [**I 'm counting on hearing from you in the next 30 minutes.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601881:Jxp6m5VN3:m:1:3317145305:A6E87A1F5CE75EE72CC0594738A71632:r)

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61601882:Jxp6m5VN3:m:1:3317145305:A6E87A1F5CE75EE72CC0594738A71632:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washin

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9n5lvu6d0mog2mgthp81lh5icgufc14hvrk55r8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuokgn8kh6ka94p8t5otgovvtcic78rjapsltll8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpadrmidk9o1eiq80g1phcsp7mso1d5inipc2mu0_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvmm6ks90o7buqh3fdub4ms9kvmpli2l6oicc7ag_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmtc0lc28kgk69d828tmh8s4sjmb8f1bkvtq2ilo_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1t0q772ktd5o4d1n3h2ljri04mdtecu46182q60_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp3pu4ndidva72b4dqpudktg9tpciq8qavof9468_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zup8a2q1hashs05l7ua13shhu02msgoesnr66di8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7ta9jeuvnn296gp465ukcrg7cbki86og335scb8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4khldsgmrl86ecmocs7hu1rt4fjov6e8hp29f88_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgvsho9mijjc75qd2i3n246a95vngg40jhgrk5k0_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo4am855dl6c9tassbeicsgic7kmrc1nsu0n2ugg_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ogm0bb1ju83agb619ski81glhut2c8bp947gi8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7tqkqqsgqdas74vcjod57dgjrm2f5k2tk4nj2r8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk7p1ugqdjoca7j73jsjkhikshcu92af5prbidd0_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4jdfh3kuc9pdlfvk97ie56f7gnug08hqorbj360_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhk6tfba27p3scqnibsng1v5c35mlp8117qf48i8_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zehl5untvn6vfu2itri8lij8er8pdkpusjrl0330_rp22sh2s8i66or5clhm1o74cph2bs "Step up now!")**_

---
|

---

name: American Update
subject: Bezos & Musk investing billions to transform America
body:
| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of [COP26?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c46836%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sVV5ruOwE1y%2bZ4t3KcN5fQ&sysid=1) Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has [signed this accord,](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c46837%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YbyYkL2ZcoS2wOeSLqdo8w&sysid=1) along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. name: Christine Drazan
subject: The perfect storm.
body:
I just finished reading this incredible rundown of our race–and I’m attaching it here and below so you don’t miss it!
_I just finished reading this incredible rundown of our race -[_**and I 'm attaching it here and below so you don't miss it!**_](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-r/)_We as Oregonians have everything going for us as we seek to take back our state from Kate Brown and Tina Kotek-and this article lays it all out on the table. [__**So, give it a read and let me know what you think!**__](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-j/) [QUICK DONATE $5 TO LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-t/) ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ [](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-i/) Deep-blue _**[Oregon](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-d/)**_ could elect a Republican as its next governor in November thanks to a particular set of circumstances that have lined up in the _**[GOP 's](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-h/)**_ favor.Republican candidate Christine Drazan led her Democratic opponent, Tina Kotek, by 2 points in an _**[Emerson College poll](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-k/)**_ this week. It was the latest sign that the party in control of Oregon for decades is struggling to convince voters to give _**[Democrats](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-u/)**_ more time at the helm. [QUICK DONATE $5 TO LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-o/) "I think this is maybe the most fascinating and surprising governor's race in the country," Jessica Taylor, the Senate and governors editor for the Cook Political Report, told the Washington Examiner. "You have kind of a confluence of different things that are giving Republicans a unique opportunity."No Republican has won an Oregon gubernatorial race in 40 years, giving Oregon one of the longest unbroken streaks of Democratic control in the country. [QUICK DONATE $5 TO LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-b/) Despite the decidedly liberal bent of the state, however, Drazan has a few advantages this cycle.Oregon's current leader is the _**[least popular governor](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-n/)**_ in the country, complicating Kotek's job of selling a similar platform to voters. Democratic Gov. Kate Brown's approval ratings have plummeted due to her perceived leniency on crime and the aggression of her pandemic-era mandates.An independent candidate, Betsy Johnson, has also chipped away at some of Kotek's support among Democrats.While Johnson has pulled voters from both parties, she's taken more Democrats than Republicans, according to the Emerson poll.Nine percent of Oregon Republicans said they planned to vote for Johnson, but 17% of Oregon Democrats said they would back the independent.Johnson's straight-talking style and deep-pocketed campaign donors have given her a significant share of support in recent polls.Phil Knight, co-founder of Nike, has _**[poured](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-p/)**_ millions of dollars into Johnson's campaign, helping her to outraise both Drazan and Kotek in a rare feat of fundraising prowess for a third-party candidate.Crime has put Kotek on defense from both of her opponents.Johnson has _**[mocked](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-x/)**_ Kotek as "tent city Tina" and complained the streets of Oregon are "a mess."A Democrat during her years in the state legislature, Johnson has adopted more centrist positions as an independent candidate this year that have popularized her with Democrats."When you have voters that are looking at sort of the status quo and not liking where things are, they're more likely to blame Democrats or seek a third option, which would be Johnson," Taylor said.Drazan has struck a strident tone on crime throughout the race. She's focused intensely on the violence that Portland city leaders have failed to contain over the past two years, which likely strikes a chord with the _**[72% of Oregonians](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-m/)**_ who say they have a negative view of Portland. [QUICK DONATE $5 TO LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-c/) Business owners have _**[closed up](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-q/)**_ shops and _**[residents have fled](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-a/)**_ since crime and homelessness have mushroomed through the streets. The vacancy rate of office space in downtown Portland has _**[roughly doubled](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-f/)**_ since 2019.Drazan has suggested she would send state troopers to the city to crack down on crime in the absence of action from Portland Democrats."If Portland leaders do not step in, specifically around riots, specifically around unrest that engages in property damage and criminal activity, if Portland leaders don't step in and resolve that, as governor, I will," she said in March.Taylor noted that Republicans are only able to benefit from the combination of dissatisfaction with Oregon Democrats' handling of crime and the spoiler role of Johnson's campaign because Drazan is such a strong candidate herself.Formerly the state legislature's Republican leader, Drazan made a name for herself in part by orchestrating a _**[walkout](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-z/)**_ of GOP caucus members in 2020 that denied state Democrats the ability to vote on climate change legislation.Republican state Rep. Daniel Bonham, a former colleague of Drazan's in the legislature, said Drazan "was like a Michael Jordan in the caucus.""That's the person who needs the ball at the end of the game," Bonham told the _**[Willamette Weekly](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-v/)**_. "She's just that exceptional." [QUICK DONATE $5 TO LEAD OREGON IN A NEW DIRECTION ☀️](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-l-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-e/) Kotek has run on a fairly standard progressive platform that avoids calling for tougher policing or harsher punishments for lawbreakers.She has continued to advocate community violence prevention programs and racial justice training for police officers rather than an increase in police budgets or the empowerment of prosecutors.### | [Unsubscribe](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail19.com/t/y-u-ntljkn-iukrjimdh-s/)

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Gave it all I had, Derek
body:
Derek,
I gave it all I had on the debate stage. Now, voting begins in Arizona today. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.
I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.
This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking — even for me. It feels like another Super PAC or dark money group is announcing another million dollar TV ad every couple days.
And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate last night, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.
Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.
I know I’ve asked a lot, Derek. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it we’re likely to lose the Senate.
So, how about it:
Can I count on you to split a $25 contribution between my re-election campaign and CommonGood to help us hold onto this seat? Anything you can give will make a BIG difference in these final days. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20221012_CGVA_Kelly]

body:
I'm proud to be endorsed by End Citizens United, a group working to end dark money in politics and strengthen voting rights. I represent the people of New Jersey, not corporations.

That's why I don't take a dime of corporate PAC money. I rely on grassroots support from people like you. And in a tough race like this one, every dollar matters. Can you give $4 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2022-10-12-ecu-s&recurring=0&amount=4&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=8d031c90-2d4a-ed11-b495-002248258d38]

Since the 2010 Citizens United decision opened the floodgates, dark money groups have spent billions of dollars to pollute our elections with misleading attack ads, dirty hit-piece mailers, and vast amounts of disinformation.

Because it's dark money, we don't know who's funding these groups or why. And there's no way to hold anyone accountable for the dishonesty – or even to engage them in a debate. We can't have a civil political discussion if the other side is hiding.

And make no mistake: that's just the way some people want it. The hiding is the point.

Most folks don't believe that the super wealthy and massive corporate interests should be able to use money as an invisibility cloak. A recent poll found that 90% of voters want to end dark money in politics by making contributions more transparent. Yet just a couple of weeks ago, Senate Republicans voted down legislation that would do exactly that.

I will never give up on our democracy and the principle that the people should have the power. So, I'm leading the charge to get dark money out of politics.

But, I'm in a tough race this year. Dark money groups are spending buckets of money to elect my right-wing opponent. Plus, he's drawing from a huge inheritance to fund his campaign. Andy

body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=83c22023cfd2568e5f710ae3c493b8fb1fd46be592dd5f3b1d63ba736bccfb27febee84d90930320d742488d49401aa55f63f4ef6c07ad6bc7b6afa0adc77204d7de9e6391529049e927fea6ed7c7ab9

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=7ddb6128a85247930d05361470a88b270b064f770fd3c1bb05e6fcbb99c42121a12d41e277ba63a9e6b03353da7ab2c247297e27f2e16a7c

Peter,

Ron DeSantis is America’s Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he’s called home since his birth.

Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.

After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney’s Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.

Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.

Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.

As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f01d3cee22780154d16e86c852b65407fbef4c71008581b98e10a8e6dc74a1f7a95a71e619ee98e3b329fe188d65205c3bc35961150c7037
>>">Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. That is who Ron DeSantis is.

He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

Casey DeSantis

I’ve delivered for Pennsylvanians

Derek, I’ll be a strong Governor for Pennsylvanians. But before I explain why you can trust me to be a Governor Pennsylvanians can count on, I need to ask for your support. Asking people for money is not something I enjoy doing, but my team informed me that we’re falling behind our online fundraising goals, so it’s necessary. **[Will you donate today to help us get back on track?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52449574/372302323/-586780698?refcode=email_101222_countonme_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=bad6df25-334a-ed11-b495-002248258d38&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWQ2ZGYyNS0zMzRhLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kn5RKo374ULV5ZtOVWhDme9b51O7AZUHh2CE53ZM9_g=)** I’ve made it my mission to put the people of Pennsylvanians first — I’ve defended our freedom to choose, our voices at the ballot box, our right to clean water and air, and our ability to provide for their families. Here’s how: As State Representative, I helped write and pass some of the toughest ethics laws in state history — taking on the status quo for Pennsylvanians. As County Commissioner, I led a fiscal and ethical turnaround. I put the county back on solid financial footing, took early steps to combat the heroin epidemic, helped the first LGBTQ+ couples in Pennsylvania marry, and fired Wall Street money managers to save taxpayers and retirees millions. As the People’s Attorney General, I exposed the Catholic Church’s decades-long cover-up of child sexual abuse, identifying 301 predator priests and thousands of victims. I forced an agreement between two of the Commonwealth’s largest insurance companies — protecting health care access for almost 2 million Pennsylvanians, and I’ve repeatedly gone to court to defend Pennsylvanians’ reproductive rights and a woman’s right to choose. During the 2020 presidential election, I protected the right to vote and defended Pennsylvania’s election results, winning in court dozens of times before and after Election Day. To this day, I’m still calling out the dangerous lies that undermine our democracy — especially the conspiracy theories coming from Doug Mastriano — and fighting to protect our voting rights in Pennsylvania. Now, in my second term, I’m continuing to stand up for Pennsylvanians, take on big fights, and deliver real results. I’m keeping our streets safe by arresting more than 8,200 drug dealers and taking thousands of illegal guns off the streets. I’ve delivered hundreds of millions in relief for Pennsylvanian students, seniors, and workers who have been ripped off by greedy corporations. **I have a track record of taking on the big fights and delivering for Pennsylvanians. Now, I’m taking on the biggest fight yet: Winning this competitive Governor’s race, beating dangerous extremist Doug Mastriano, and defending all of our freedoms.** But to win, I need your help. This campaign can’t be won by one person or even a handful — it’ll take a huge, powerful team to win in a swing state like Pennsylvania, why is why I’m asking for your support today: **[Derek, will you donate today to our people-powered campaign? Democrats and Republicans couldn't be in more different places right now. Take the economy for example. Democrats are doing everything we can to try to bring down costs for families. Look at the Inflation Reduction Act. What did we do? Work to bring down the cost of health care. Give Medicare a chance to negotiate prescription drug prices. Put a cap on what people pay for insulin. Put a cap on what seniors have to pay for prescriptions. And on top of that, we're putting in place this giant climate plan, which will bring down utility costs for families. And by the way, all paid for by a 15% minimum tax on massive corporate profits. And where are Republicans on this? They scream, they yell, they say “Inflation!” over and over. And what are the number of ideas they have for what to do about it? Zero. While Democrats are delivering on health care, lowering utility costs, and student loan debt — you know, things to actually bring down costs for families — Republicans are not contributing at all. Their ideas are, _“Don't do those things.”_ They all continue to vote against the solutions to bring down costs for families, and then they go home. And when there's actually something delivered, like a new infrastructure project, they still show up at the ribbon cutting and say, _"You're welcome, you're welcome"_ to everybody while they fought on the opposite side. And the thing is, it's not just that Republicans have no good ideas for dealing with inflation. It's not only they're fighting the things we're trying to do. They're actually looking for things that would make the economy affirmatively worse, for tens of millions of American families. Things like putting Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block. That’s the difference between the two parties right now. Democrats are fighting to try to make life better for working people, to expand opportunity, and try to deal with the real problems that people have. And the Republicans that have just become extremists. Extremists on abortion. Extremists on making excuses for the attack on our democracy on January 6. Extremists on putting billionaires and giant corporations ahead of working families. We've got an election coming up in November, where we’ve got a chance to affect the direction that our nation takes. I can understand if you may be feeling worried about the future, but I’m feeling hopeful at this moment. If we can come together and elect two more Democratic Senators who are willing to roll back the filibuster (I'm looking at you Mandela Barnes in Wisconsin, and John Fetterman in Pennsylvania), and if we hang on to the House, we can continue to make transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth anymore, but as a powerful majority. We can actually ensure the right to vote, and the right to get that vote counted. We can ensure that Roe v. Wade is the law of the land everywhere. We can pass universal child care. We can pass immigration reform. But we won’t be able to get _anything_ done if the Republicans take control. So this is the moment to use your hope, to motivate yourself to get out there, give some money, make some phone calls, knock on some doors, and make it happen. This is how we each own a piece of our democracy — by fighting side by side. | | | President Biden made history last week when he took major steps to overhaul federal marijuana laws. “No one should be in jail just for using or possessing marijuana,” Biden said. We couldn’t agree more! Biden pardoned all prior federal offenses of simple marijuana possession and called for governors to do the same at the state level. This is huge – too many lives have been upended just for possessing marijuana, and communities of color have been disproportionately impacted. There’s more work to be done here, but this is an important step forward. Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. [**I 'm counting on hearing from you in the next 30 minutes.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61610609:6FyBH5VRN:m:1:3331421248:21FFFBB809251FAD9E34207EA0D3854E:r)

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/ospXd6XhNf

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60921858:spXd6XhNf:m:3:2532013465:4EDE55C27DF26A10E6F897DD7CF9AB3E:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60921858:spXd6XhNf:m:3:2532013465:4EDE55C27DF26A10E6F897DD7CF9AB3E:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

###### _A Message from..._
##### John Philip Sousa IV
###### National Chairman of Stars & Stripes Forever PAC
###### _Formerly the 2016 Committee and National Draft Ben Carson for President Committee_
| Dear Peter, We are now just about 30 days out from the midterms and the stakes are high... Without a doubt, the outcome of this election will determine the direction our country heads for the next two years. Will the Socialists have a clear path for passing more legislation increasing the cost and size of government, taking away more of our constitutional freedoms and destroying our economy and international standing among our Allies? Or will we elect more America First men and women and send many of those Liberals home? I want that direction to be the road blocking of President Biden's and the Democrats' socialist agenda during the 2nd half of Biden's presidency. Economic experts predict that in addition to a weaker economy, Americans across all income groups will face higher taxes in the next two years. In fact, just with the passage of the Inflation Reduction Act, taxpayers in every single income category (from $10,000 on up) will pay higher taxes... That's why we must fight to stop him! Frankly, we don't have the financial resources that the national parties do, but we do have our successful _**Nadler Method and you**_ in our arsenal. So while the parties are fighting to win contests around the nation, we have identified three key Senate races and six congressional seats where lifting the Black and Latino vote for Republicans can secure victories and give us more leverage in blocking the Democrats oppressive agenda during the 2nd half of Biden's presidency. Pollsters are calling all these races toss-ups and each have a high percentage of Black and/or Latino Voters. They are:
# Senate:
* Arizona - Kelly (D-Incumbent) vs. Masters (R-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO GAIN IT**
* Georgia - Warnock (D-Incumbent vs. Walker (R-Challenger) - **We NEED TO GAIN IT**
* Pennsylvania - Open seat due to Republican Pat Toomey's retirement. Fetterman (D) vs. Dr. Oz (R) - **WE NEED TO HOLD IT**

# House:
* NC-13 - Open seat due to Republican Richard Burr's retirement. Nickel (D) vs. Hines (R) - **WE NEED TO HOLD IT**
* OH-01 -Chabot (R-Incumbent) vs. Landsman (D-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO HOLD IT**
* OH-09 - Kaptur (D-Incumbent) vs. J.R. Majewski (R-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO GAIN IT**

name: Laurie Teper
subject: 8 days until early voting begins!
body:
Hello Team Geels!
The days are counting down and we need all hands on deck! **The most important role and top priority is to volunteer your time handing out Courtney Geels cards at the polling locations across all 5 counties. **We are continuing to schedule people and the goal is to get every polling site covered! Thank you to everyone who has committed their time to this effort!
Hear it directly from Courtney here: <https://photos.app.goo.gl/EPka4UGSBVPLLTYu8>

We are still waiting for the shirts to arrive. The County Coordinators will convey to you their supply pick up times which will include shirts if you need them and palm cards. Please take enough palm cards to cover all of your shifts. We have plenty of them! If you are only working one shift, please pass your extras on to the person following you. Reminder emails will go out one day prior with the schedule for the day so you will know who will be before or after you (or no one if it isn't filled).

YOU ASKED AND NOW WE HAVE COURTNEY GEELS BUTTONS! They will be added into your supplies. Thank you to Bob Castona for making them!

If you haven't been able to join in on the training sessions, Courtney recorded the last one. Please view it at your convenience. It's about 25 minutes.
<https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cGV7Ih_iegAaCoTYmKoXyrjyNFhJjjvU/view?usp=sharing>

_Events this Weekend and into Tuesday!_
_
_
_Alamance Sign Waving - Friday, Oct. 14 - 4:30pm-5:30pm_
Alamance Republican Women promoting Courtney Geels and Ted Budd

Meet at the Harris Teeter on Huffman Mill and Church St.
You will be holding Courtney Geels signs and waving them as traffic goes by. Volunteers have said this has been a lot of fun! Expect a lot of cars honking in agreement!
Contact Corrie: [Corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:Corrieshep@gmail.com) / [(336) 578-4059](tel:+13365784059)

_Durham Door Knocking - Saturday, Oct. 15 - 9:00am-NOON_

Meet at 1720 Guess Rd (parking lot between Sears and C&H cafeteria)
Contact Renee: [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com) / [919-880-6810](tel:+19198806810)

_Alamance Door Knocking with Team Ross- Saturday, Oct. 15 - 9:00am-NOON_
Meet at GOP Headquarters
2643 Ramada Rd in Burlington
Contact Corrie: [Corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:Corrieshep@gmail.com) / [(336) 578-4059](tel:+13365784059)

_Durham Hispanic Outreach Ice Cream Social - Saturday, Oct. 15 - 1:00pm-3:00pm_
2000 Avondale Dr, Durham
Contact Renee: [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com) / [919-880-6810](tel:+19198806810)
_
_
_LAST Kinfolk Concert Series - Saturday, Oct. 15 - 7:00pm-9:00pm_
104 E. Elm St
Sheriff Terry Johnson will be there. Wear your shirts (layered with long sleeves underneath) and stop at the Courtney Geels booth! Bring your chairs or bring your blankets and enjoy some quality time with local kinfolk. This is an outdoor concert series & there will be vendors at each event
[ _https://www.visitalamance.com/event/kinfolk-concert-series%3A-south-of-southern-aaron-silver/23714/_](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.visitalamance.com/event/kinfolk-concert-series%253A-south-of-southern-aaron-silver/23714/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1665926602351326&usg=AOvVaw1qcn9ShBZ8gxJ-xZSWzSl0)

In case you missed the interviews of Courtney and Valerie on Spectrum News, watch it at this link: <https://spectruminfocus.com/section/in-focus/regions/nc>

Share this link with potential **volunteers** to sign up:

[https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/)

Share this link with potential **donors to donate** :
[https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today](https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today)

Please take videos and photos (in a vertical position) at any event and send them to our Social Media Director, Caroline Johnson at [caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com.](http://caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com./)

Your County Coordinators:
_Person_ : Jason Chambers - [JWCham8786@gmail.com](mailto:JWCham8786@gmail.com) / [(919) 630-0514](tel:+19196300514)
_Orange_ : Marianne Link - [marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com) / [919-740-3503](tel:919-740-3503)

Follow us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/courtneygeels), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtneygeels/), and give us a like on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/CourtneyGeelsForCongress) to keep up with Courtney.

Be sure to like and share!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04

While South Carolinians are suffering, Henry McMaster and Pamela Evette are trying to polarize us more, not less. Their latest ad attacks Joe and me for working across the aisle to find solutions. _That’s not what we need from our leaders._

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I’m Verlene Warnock, Raphael’s mom. I’m reaching out on behalf of my son because he’s working so hard right now to give Georgians like me a voice in the Senate and move our country forward. In a moment, I'm going to ask you to make a contribution to help Raphael win his campaign for reelection – **but first, I hope you'll let me share a little bit about myself and why your support is so important.**

When I was growing up, Jim Crow segregation was at its full power. I spent my summers picking cotton on land I didn’t own, and then went on to become a pastor. My husband – also a pastor – and I taught all 12 of our children the importance of not just dreaming about change and impact, but _making it_. We taught them about the power of community and service – of having a spiritual home and nourishing it like it nourishes you.
**I always knew Raphael was going places, but I never imagined one of those places would be the U.S. Senate.** I can't say I'm surprised: When Raphael was a boy, he would go to the library and come back with a stack of books as tall as he was, dreaming about changing the world.

No matter what hardships we faced as family, he never let his circumstances keep him from thinking and acting big. That's who Raphael is.
With your help last year, he flipped Georgia blue for the first time in years – and I can't express how grateful we were for your support. Now, he's in the Senate fighting to cut costs of prescription drugs, to expand voting rights, and to ensure all children to have access to the same opportunities he had.
**But Raphael's back on the ballot __ this year – and he won't be able to defend his Senate seat and keep up this critical work without grassroots folks like you. _NPR_ is saying he's the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection, and folks on the other side are spending millions to defeat him.**
I'm so proud of my son. I know how dedicated he is to living a life of service and making positive change for our community. But in a race this close and competitive, he needs supporters like you by his side to win. **[I’m personally asking, friend: Will you chip in what you can for my son to help him defend his seat in the Senate, win in Georgia, and keep on fighting for families like yours and ours?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52445686/372287282/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4556-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2I2NmI4YS0yZTRhLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=83Bz9KsP87NcIPV5BcuO1EyowGkqU39IclZOMGgW2F4=)**
Thank you so much.

body:
And--don't miss Dominic's first Debate next Tuesday!

View this email in your browser (https://us16.campaign-archive.com/?e=8763c56857&u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=4596ad7e97)
https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=3e1254278a&e=8763c56857
https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=a4c6ec3774&e=8763c56857

** Early Voting—What are We Trying to Solve?
------------------------------------------------------------

This Election Day, you will see a question about early voting on the ballot. This same proposed amendment was voted down in 2014 and reappears now as an open-ended proposal that, if affirmed, would give unlimited powers to lawmakers to extend early voting in any manner and for any duration as decided by a simple majority of lawmakers.

Early voting is not right for Connecticut and is a solution looking for a problem. Here’s why:
* Chaos with Election Officials: Early Voting states have full-time election officials while Connecticut has mostly part-time Registrars.Thirty days of early voting, for example, would introduce chaos to this group of professionals. This would affect their full-time employment and leave municipalities scrambling for personnel replacements and/or funds to pay for overtime.
* Connecticut has Decentralized Voting: In states with early voting, elections are organized around county-based elections whereas several towns are aggregated around early voting precincts with full resources. Connecticut would have to establish at least one voting precinct in 169 towns for an unspecified period of operation.
* Unfunded Mandate: Establishing voting centers in 169 towns, with part-time registrars, for up to 30 days could cost as much as $15M to $20M in personnel and site rentals. Most schools would not be available as election centers.
* Reduced Voter Engagement: Connecticut primaries end in mid-August and early voting begins as early as week 2 of October. This leaves 6-8 weeks for voter engagement and education before the first votes are cast.
* Smaller Campaigns Disenfranchised: The extension of Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts could make it cost-prohibitive for small campaigns to compete over a prolonged period.

The Bottom Line: Early voting reduces a voter’s opportunity to learn more about the issues, and the candidates. Additionally, voters may miss the revelations of an “October surprise.”And Connecticut already has one of the highest voter turnouts in the country. So what problem are we trying to solve?

** Don’t Miss Dominic’s Debate Next Week!
------------------------------------------------------------

Next Tuesday, October, Sept. 18, the rescheduled debate against my opponent, Democrat Stephanie Thomas—which will air across allCT Public platforms (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=95708ccef5&e=8763c56857) , including PBS and NPR, beginning at 8 p.m. The debate will take place at the Lincoln Theater on the campus of the University of Hartford and is sponsored by the League of Women Voters.

I look forward to representing our principles and values on this very important stage.

I hope you will tune in!

Thank you and Godspeed,

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

body:

| | | Patriot,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608907:Jqldz5VNq:m:1:3299561967:BD89E18BAAC6F5381ED95186C6973923:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Patriot, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

body:
I'll be blunt [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6416%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=NFjUR2AhMzM1shMNC4QSfg&sysid=1)
I'll be blunt

|
---
| | | I'll be blunt, Friend.

My biggest deadline of the year is here, and if we don't raise enough to meet my goal by midnight, you can say goodbye to Trump's legacy.

Here are the facts:
* Fox News said my race will be the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history.
* My opponent outraised me FIVE QUARTERS in a row.
* My opponent’s last financial report showed she raised more in just one month than I did in THREE months.

body:

Hi Derek – it's Chrissy.

I wanted to make sure you saw Shane's message. We just launched our first campaign ad of the election, "Dreams." I am deeply grateful that thanks to your support, we've been able to begin spreading our message to voters across PA-06.
In Dreams, I discuss how my experiences as a mom in the Air Force and running a business informed my efforts in Congress to expand paid family leave – making it easier for working parents to pursue their dreams. As Pennsylvania parents struggle with rising costs, we need them to know that I get it and am working to make things easier.

clean_body: | | | Peter, When I met Hung Cao for the first time, I was honestly surprised. He wasn’t stiff or cold like I’d imagined politicians. He was eager to learn, eager to serve, and ready to do the REAL work to make Congress run for the American people. I knew in that moment I wanted to work on his campaign. Every day since then, Hung has shown me the true value of hard work and courage. We need less politicians and more leaders, and he embodies the very essence of what it means to be a leader. Now, I need your help to send this incredible hero to Congress. Hung didn't spend his life in politics, Peter. Before this race, he’d spent over 25 years fighting in the most dangerous corners of the world as a Naval Officer. He never wanted fame or glory; he just wanted to help his country. But after watching Joe Biden fumble our freedom again and again, Hung knew he couldn’t sit by idly. Now, he’s on a new mission, and he can’t finish it without your help. name: Martin Sheen
subject: I’m personally asking you
body:
Derek - I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: Donald Trump just left Nevada where he held a MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control.
If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power.
I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority.
I’m personally asking you: Will you split $25 between Catherine’s campaign and CommonGood to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM&amount=50]

DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM]
I've been an activist my entire life, Derek. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to usher in great progress for this nation.
But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election.
If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president.
It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win.
Please, split a contribution of $25 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto win in Nevada and protect our Democratic Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221012_CGVA_CCM]
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

| | Friend,**

** With the election right around the corner, Team Schmidt wanted to take the opportunity to outline [Derek Schmidt’s plan for a better Kansas in his first 100 days](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=d32fab80fa884c83af718e52ce78981e&_e=rW8_jGEiCzxNRScVWlHrexU_BwVSA9O_A2NHUIWrK1RjsA_MIMOSR_nDpehIG9pg-FbYLrE4GmCnajFMZ5dRiQFysDJtV2PYmU3Xf4P5M1f3CVea8JTN8JcQ2Q-6U-FYx-DlBzKdImxONQwIO8xARUdJiNSzJIqIGWqlOpFgzrU92a6ThikhM52vB4pYdLsLNRtduieVooV5AJlMWwDFv6fFCh-54PAyc5lh3r4ztz8%3D) as your next governor. Derek has four main priorities for Kansas: make daily life more affordable for Kansans, put kids and parents first, build safer and healthier communities, and grow a healthy state economy. We believe in more transparency from the governor’s office, and that’s why we wanted to lay out Derek’s plan over the next few days. **This is Derek’s plan for making daily life more affordable for Kansans:****
**
✔️Derek will propose to the Legislature a balanced state budget that slows the rate of growth of state spending, which has exploded at an unsustainable rate under the current administration. ✔️Enact his Retire Tax-Free plan to help and encourage more Kansans to retire here by exempting pensions, Social Security, and dedicated retirement distributions from state income tax. ✔️Exempt diapers and feminine hygiene products from state sales tax. ✔️Adjust the Homestead Property Tax program and the homestead property tax exemption to prevent Kansans from losing their homes because of inflation. ✔️Pay off more public debt, including in the public pension system, to protect KPERS retirees and save taxpayers millions of dollars in debt-service payments for years and generations to come. While Laura Kelly avoids being transparent about her plans for Kansas, Derek Schmidt has outlined a clear purpose and plan for the people of Kansas. That’s why he is the right choice to be the next governor of Kansas. Friend —
I gave it all I had on the debate stage last week. Now, voting begins in Arizona today. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.
I'm gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I'll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.
This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking — even for me. It feels like another Super PAC or dark money group is announcing another million dollar TV ad every couple days.
And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate last week, we've got to be able to set the record straight.
Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It's a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.
I know I've asked a lot, team. But I really need your help, and the ball's in your court now. This seat is at risk, and if we don't hold onto it we're likely to lose the Senate.
So, how about it:

| | | | | Peter, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. First, I’d like to tell you why I’m writing you 27 days before the election. **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T761be247-3754-4e80-beff-5eadc205fc96/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion.
