[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

Peter,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

"Why?" you may ask.

As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604015:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**" One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity."**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

**Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Peter, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604007:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Peter, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61604008:6RHet5VNv:m:1:3346849603:38BB17A3BB0745AB79AF1E0218004A50:r)

Candace Owens

body:
All this dark money funding Dr. Oz’s campaign. 😬
#
Derek,
**Here’s what you need to know about the status of Dr. Oz’s fundraising:**
➡️ Dr. Oz announced he raised $17 million last quarter (which included a $7 million check from his personal fortune).
➡️ Dr. Oz flew to California for a fundraiser with Senator Rick Scott + a *minimum* donation of $5,000 per plate... AND spoke in front of a car owned + used by Adolf Hitler as his backdrop.
➡️ Million$ of GOP-backed PACs are pouring money into our state to buy this Senate seat — including Donald Trump’s Super PAC.
Here’s the thing about how you fund a campaign: It shows who you’re working for. I purposefully fund my campaign with small-dollar grassroots donations because when I am elected to the Senate, I’m going to fight like hell for the working people.
In other words, we don’t take any of the dirty, icky money (as Gisele puts it).
**[To compete with Dr. Oz’s million$, we are building a strong movement of grassroots supporters. And today, I’m *humbly* asking for your support. Will you make a contribution of any amount toward my campaign today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-1?refcode=em20221012-7678&refcode2=7678_434096_8n3_Zp&akid=7678%2E434096%2E8n3_Zp)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221012-7678&refcode2=7678_434096_8n3_Zp&akid=7678%2E434096%2E8n3_Zp)**
The stakes are high in Pennsylvania.
Dr. Oz isn’t just a phony + fraud who literally isn’t from PA, he’s a malicious scam artist who knowingly hurt regular people to line his own pockets. And now he uses that money to personally fund his campaign.
Oz has shown us who he is — and we should believe him. We can’t leave this up to chance, and I’m fighting with everything I’ve got to win this seat.
**I’m asking you to make a contribution today — every dollar we raise between now and the election will make the biggest difference.[Derek, will you chip in today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-1?refcode=em20221012-7678&refcode2=7678_434096_8n3_Zp&akid=7678%2E434096%2E8n3_Zp)**
We deserve better than Dr. Oz.
Thank you for your support today,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

body:
We’re launching a radio and digital ad campaign to set the record straight and turn out the vote in support of gun safety champions.
#

Friends -
Today, we’re proud to be launching a six-figure Spanish language radio and digital advertising campaign in Florida.
We’re less than three weeks away from the midterm elections. The results of these elections are critical. They’ll not only determine whether or not we maintain our gun safety majorities in the House and Senate, but they’ll also decide if we elect state and local leaders ready to fight for gun safety in their local communities.
Florida Republicans want more guns in more places—but gun safety champions up and down the ballot are running on real, lifesaving solutions.
We’re launching our ad campaign to set the record straight and turn out the vote in support of gun safety champions like Janelle Perez.
But here’s the thing. Ad campaigns are expensive, and if we want to keep our ads running, we need your support.
[**So please, will you use this link to watch our new ad and chip in $3 today to help us get out the vote in Florida during the last few weeks until Election Day?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/22617?c0=giffords-em-oct22-flvideo.BfpH1o&refcode=em221012-1-15&t=1&akid=2592%2E3935704%2EeybHmw)

body:
Dear Peter,

Election Day is 28 days away and absentee ballots are hitting mailboxes. On November 8th, please vote to ensure that education remains a priority over politics in Broward County.
I have had the honor to serve as your Countywide School Board Member for 11 years. In that time, I have been a champion for student success and modernizing the school system. I have asked the hard questions and worked tirelessly to ensure that our public school system continues to be accountable to our community. I have also worked collaboratively with community leaders and organizations, across the district, to build effective partnerships to benefit our students, teachers, and staff.

That is why I am incredibly proud to have earned the support of the following organizations:
Broward Teachers Union (BTU)
Broward County AFL-CIO
Broward County Council of Professional Firefighters
Broward Principals and Administrators Association (BPAA)
The Hispanic Vote
Equality Florida Action PAC
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/102049/images/image001.jpg]
I am truly grateful for the vote of confidence from educators, labor unions, first responders and leading advocacy organizations. I have earned their support because they know that I will continue to be a champion for our children, parents and staff and that I am dedicated to education and our community.
I hope you will join them in supporting my campaign.
Thank you,

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: Patriot, this is my story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Patriot,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Patriot. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608992:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608993:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608993:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608993:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608994:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608995:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61608995:66lAx5VNm:m:1:3299561967:DCE6B3FAAEB56593F67AA419446FF4BF:r "Step up now!")**_

---

---

name: Casey DeSantis
subject: Our Story
body:
| | | **[RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT TO RE-ELECT GOVERNOR RON DESANTIS!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)**
---
| | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
Peter, Ron DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth.__
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
| | Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. **[Rush in your support to help us keep fighting>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r "Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>")**

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

_**[Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband's re-election? >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r "Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for
my husband’s re-election? >>>")**_
---
[**SUPPORT GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
[**KEEP FLORIDA FREE >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
[**RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)
---
Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis
---
[**MAKE A DONATION**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616586:JlA6F5VpN:m:1:3331421248:A9E695A4EBCF5B13A05048D24E962CB2:r)

Our new TV ad premiered today and I wanted YOU to be the first to watch it.

body:
| | |
---
This is the first email breaking down our 4-step plan to fix our _**BROKEN**_ higher education system and expand the American Dream, friend. **_Step 1 →_**
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=5e9ca608a6de486a9fc40199d058d007&_e=8t0q214DG05Nf2JWKgCIIvDXE09b1NNMyHoDvnuI6fgmaAGvPwiIic5Brat6OJ3C62qXKTonnjmfb_KVqkPfGnGuLk4U7P-zu4TLc89f6ByYSxbtOp46Mtk3xggxWaW2BDDXK1O9ePwZmKbBil8AVpcYykydbM0XJihaTlZti0fKzHTvXlC3WbMbg8w79TTMjj70Cp2RIetiaG8Y2uV2tGkg7LtAH5SonnlAk4m8zbSdjQM91CNxLxPc0JPoHDwUxnQ30I3nESsg8vMtv6kCSQ%3D%3D)
---
_**An America United**_ is working with leaders like Governor Larry Hogan, who launched a successful _**first-in-the-nation**_ initiative to eliminate the four-year degree requirement for thousands of state jobs. He recognizes the value of skills that are developed on the job, or through apprenticeship programs, community college, or military service. Americans should be able to get well-paying jobs without accumulating mountains of student loan debt if they want jobs that also require a specific skill they possess or want to learn. _**Step 2 →**_
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=5e9ca608a6de486a9fc40199d058d007&_e=8t0q214DG05Nf2JWKgCIIvDXE09b1NNMyHoDvnuI6fgmaAGvPwiIic5Brat6OJ3C62qXKTonnjmfb_KVqkPfGnGuLk4U7P-zu4TLc89f6ByYSxbtOp46Mtk3xggxWaW2IFKyY6JyIknmMdF3eTumYhsSmz3sJARVpDJy9fSa9a1NB8mCt-CMGJ_G8SR6kol3DV2lhC-KvBGolFhUi3lS-GcebkPaVTNguMo0ZExC35kdEFrJn4XW1Rkp8Mx8__YnDLA5eyrNbRwigJN_z67Bng%3D%3D)
---
We must value alternative postsecondary education that provides on-the-job training for college and non-college students! An excellent model to follow is Governor Hogan's EARN program, which partners our workforce with industries to develop job training programs. An analysis of the program found that for every $1 of the state funding invested, an additional $17.32 is put back into the economy. We must expand the federal government's Registered Apprenticeship system to cover more careers, as it currently only covers a narrow subset.
---
| |
---
Tens of thousands of Americans have signed up and are following this growing national movement. But our committed members have helped us craft, distribute, and work with elected officials on plans like this. [**Contribute now to become a sustaining member and help AAU spread our message across the country!**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=5e9ca608a6de486a9fc40199d058d007&_e=8t0q214DG05Nf2JWKgCIIvDXE09b1NNMyHoDvnuI6fgmaAGvPwiIic5Brat6OJ3C62qXKTonnjmfb_KVqkPfGnGuLk4U7P-zu4TLc89f6ByYSxbtOp46Mtk3xggxWaW2WPiBbH9QskchSTuwuu86VjmZLjRPkoSPvJgpkCJmoKN21JqRdAAX6zro_TbLzuOV7T0itnqXzkZkRXw3kQ1GCvIMhoBXlcEJ9l1kB96HBtpzj6EaOTOhhs-CiBtfv64yuVgel_TkweCnX0qbQCIbYQ%3D%3D)

clean_body: | | | This is the first email breaking down our 4-step plan to fix our BROKEN higher education system and expand the American Dream, friend. Step 1 → An America United is working with leaders like Governor Larry Hogan, who launched a successful first-in-the-nation initiative to eliminate the four-year degree requirement for thousands of state jobs. He recognizes the value of skills that are developed on the job, or through apprenticeship programs, community college, or military service. Americans should be able to get well-paying jobs without accumulating mountains of student loan debt if they want jobs that also require a specific skill they possess or want to learn. Step 2 → We must value alternative postsecondary education that provides on-the-job training for college and non-college students! An excellent model to follow is Governor Hogan's EARN program, which partners our workforce with industries to develop job training programs. An analysis of the program found that for every $1 of the state funding invested, an additional $17.32 is put back into the economy. We must expand the federal government's Registered Apprenticeship system to cover more careers, as it currently only covers a narrow subset. | | Tens of thousands of Americans have signed up and are following this growing national movement. I've been an activist my entire life, friend. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the _millions_ , to usher in great progress for this nation.
But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election.

name: Casey DeSantis
subject: dedicated to the people of Florida
body:
| | | **[RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT TO RE-ELECT GOVERNOR RON DESANTIS!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)**
---
| | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
Peter, Ron DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth.__
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
| | Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. **[Rush in your support to help us keep fighting>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r "Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>")**

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

_**[Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband's re-election? >>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r "Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for
my husband’s re-election? >>>")**_
---
[**SUPPORT GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---
[**KEEP FLORIDA FREE >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61616573:6mJSe5VNo:m:1:3317145305:3193FAC366C7F1CF7BD71AFF3A037A82:r)
---

---
Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis

But yesterday, the far-right majority on the U.S. Supreme Court decided a date written on the outside envelope of a ballot and other minor errors like it are grounds to disenfranchise eligible voters. That makes this already concerning headline even worse: = = = The PA GOP is exploiting their legislative majority to stop any progress on commonsense mail voting laws — all so they can spread misinformation and seize on the gray areas as an excuse to disenfranchise the Commonwealth’s voters. And remember, attacks against mail voting disproportionately disenfranchise young voters and voters of color, who are significantly more likely to have their legitimate, on-time mail-in ballots rejected. * Unaffiliated voters make up the biggest voting in my district by large margins. More than 150,000 voters neither belong to the Democrat or Republican Party. **To win our race, we must win this voting bloc.**

* According to the most recent internal poll, **some 4% of voters remain undecided.** These voters are the voters that will ultimately decide the race. It's so important that we win these voters over before voters start casting ballots on October 19th.

**Please help me and my team reach as many undecided voters as we can over the next 27 days.**

Peter, Last Thursday, President Biden announced that he had pardoned all prior federal sentences for simple possession of marijuana — an important and overdue step that will help thousands of Americans, disproportionately people of color, who have been denied opportunities and benefits because of the failed War on Drugs. **Dan applauds President Biden’s decision — but he knows that much more must be done to ensure that Americans are no longer criminalized or incarcerated for possessing marijuana, and to remedy the decades of over-policing and unjust prosecution of communities of color.** That’s why Dan supports the federal legalization of marijuana and believes that marijuana should be removed from the federal government’s classification level, which currently places it above lethal drugs like fentanyl and methamphetamine. And it’s why Dan believes that governors across the country should follow President Biden’s lead by pardoning state-level offenses — which constitute the vast majority of possession cases. **[Peter, if you agree, add your name next to Dan’s to call for the legalization and descheduling of marijuana. Our limited TV ADS are being drowned out by my opponent, who is running 4 TIMES as many TV ADS on broadcast TV right now. body:
Folks — As a former United States Air Force officer that served as the United States Selective Service System Director in the Obama administration, I’m whole-heartedly supporting John Lira in the race for the Texas 23rd Congressional District.

Before I tell you more about why I support John, will you rush a contribution to his campaign to make sure the people of TX-23 have a real champion fighting for them in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221006Romo_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=3]

Donate now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221006Romo_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_EL15&amount=3]

For those less familiar with John, here is what you need to know.

1. John is a former United States Marine who has dedicated his life to serving and protecting our country.

2. He supports safe gun ownership, LGBTQ rights, reproductive rights, and voting rights for all. Endorsed by Beto O’Rourke, VoteVets, Common Defense, and unions in TX-23, John wants to make our schools safer for our children and support veteran families.

3. John was on the ground with Uvalde families in the aftermath of the tragic school shooting. His opponent, Tony Gonzales, is on record saying that he checked in with the NRA before voting on gun legislation in the House.

4. Despite Tony Gonzales having a campaign war chest of nearly $2 million, John has the momentum on the ground in this race.

The truth is, John is the servant leader we need more of in Congress — unlike Tony Gonzales who only serves himself and his special interests. So, will you chip in $3 to give John’s campaign the resources he needs to beat Tony in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221006Romo_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=3]

Thanks,

The Honorable Larry Romo

**About Jim Jordan:** | Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

This poll might’ve been conducted by a Democrat firm who worked for Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden – but we can’t take anything for granted. This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he’s leading. Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. JAYME STEVENSON, 4TH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT INDEPENDENT & REPUBLICAN CANDIDATE, TO DEBATE INCUMBENT JIM HIMES

Fairfield, Conn. — Jayme Stevenson, the Independent and Republican Candidate for Congress in Connecticut’s 4th Congressional district, will debate incumbent candidate Jim Himes tomorrow evening at 8PM at Norwalk Community College.
Jayme stated, “I am looking forward to the debate to share my views and concerns on the current climate of our district. I intend to immediately address the issues our state and district are facing when in Washington, and challenge my opponent’s record on his 14 years in office representing the residents of Connecticut. As the endorsed Independent Candidate, public servant for many years, businesswoman, mother, and a constituent of this district, I know firsthand the struggles families and businesses are currently facing. I will be focused on advocating in Washington for the needs of the cities and towns in our district and work collaboratively with state leadership to optimize funding and ensure projects are completed.
I hope voters of Southwestern Connecticut will tune in to learn more about how I will immediately focus on addressing our needs over any political party or special interest. I will be a champion for our businesses, families, women, and children, and ensure Washington is working for us.”

Hello fellow patriot,Like most of you, I spend quite a bit of time reading and thinking about the news. The other day while skimming headlines I came across something interesting that I decided to look into.It was a quote."I think [Roe v Wade] went too far. I don't think that a woman has the sole right to say what should happen to her body." ~ Joe Biden, 1974To be fair I don't think Joe remembers taking that stance, much less saying that quote. But its real. He said it. And this perfectly highlighted something that has been on my mind lately.The Democrat Party has changed so many times over so many decades that it hardly resembles anything it ever once stood for, meanwhile the very concept of Conservatism has stayed true to one thing -- The US Constitution.
| [PROTECT THE US CONSTITUTION!](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=7d5c18bee7&e=fdefed58de)
---
While they want to experiment with radical forms of government and flirt with disaster, we have always wanted no more than to stick to the foundation that was laid out for us.**Conservatives have always had one goal, to preserve the Constitution. Period.** The Democrat Party of today doesn't want the same things it wanted 30, 40, 50 years ago; who's to say what they'll want in the next decade? We cannot take that risk.America needs strong Republican candidates who are wiling to fight back to uphold the integrity of the doctrine of our nation.**I'm running in VA-03 and I'm not just focusing on my own race, I'm helping every freshman candidate I believe is fit for this fight. Any donation here would help us all tremendously.** What gives me hope in this fight is knowing that there are Americans like you out there who believe in our nation, and believe we can save it.
| [DONATE TO OUR CAMPAIGN TODAY!](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=0ba8854af0&e=fdefed58de)
---
I've created a coalition of voters who are TIRED of the 33-year incumbent and his liberal policies. He went into Congress having one set of beliefs and is now firmly in the radical Leftist camp of AOC and her Squad.He wouldn't even recognize who he is now. I've gained the support of our Governor Glenn Youngkin, our Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears, Rep. Byron Donalds, Rep. Burgess Owens and so many more.
I'm ready to lead this fight and I'm ready to WIN! Can I count on your most generous support today in helping me win back the 3rd District of Virginia?**It's all hands on deck! LET'S GET THIS DONE!**
| [PITCH IN TO US RIGHT NOW!](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=17208eb568&e=fdefed58de)

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221012&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221012&amount=28]
Friend,
As we close in on Election Day, I wanted to send you a quick note about a key part of our strategy: MSU students.
A significant part of our strategy has been trying to talk to as many MSU students as we possibly can, and registering them to vote in East Lansing. They weren’t on campus during my last election in 2020, so we’re making sure they have all the information they need to vote on campus this time around.
To help with our registration efforts, we’ve been hosting “dorm storms.” Essentially, this involves our part-time student organizers distributing registration information to the students that live in their *actual* dorm.
Peer-to-peer outreach has been the name of the game here. Because students don’t watch traditional TV in the same way their parents do, they are much less likely to see my television ads. As a result, we’ve found fellow students providing them with information has been a much more effective way to reach this group.
If you want to help us with our student outreach, consider chipping in below. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221012&amount=28] The student organizers I mentioned earlier make $22 an hour, and when all is said and done, a two hour “dorm storm” costs about $150 to execute. So, anything you are willing to contribute helps us get out the word on campus! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221012&amount=28]

subject: My friends, The Flippable Five

body:
The Flippable Five Fund helps our campaigns compete in some of the most targeted races this cycle. Now we need your help again.
#
Hey Derek, it’s John Fetterman.
I’m reaching out about my friends running for Senate in some of the most important races across the country: **Mandela Barnes in Wisconsin, Cheri Beasley in North Carolina, Val Demings in Florida, and Tim Ryan in Ohio.**
Back in August, we launched the Flippable Five Fund to help our campaigns compete in some of the most important + targeted races this cycle — and we saw a HUGE response.
_Now we need your help again._
National Republicans + dark money Super PACs are spending MILLION$ to tear me + my friends down and with less than a month until Election Day, we’re running out of time to fight back. Our Democratic Senate majority hinges on these races, Derek.
**[So please, can you rush $5 to the Flippable Five Fund today? Your donation will be split evenly between our campaigns + will play an important role in helping us win these five critical seats in November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-2?refcode=em20221012-7682&refcode2=7682_434096_lhcpFd&akid=7682%2E434096%2ElhcpFd)**
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221012-7682&refcode2=7682_434096_lhcpFd&akid=7682%2E434096%2ElhcpFd)**
Look, Derek, we can’t afford to take *anything* for granted this year.
Thanks to unprecedented GOP $$$, Mandela, Cheri, Val, Tim + I are all in neck-and-neck races to flip these seats from 🔴 to 🔵. And over these next 27 days, they’ll continue spending whatever it takes to tear our campaigns down + take back their Republican Senate majority.
**This midterm election is an all hands on deck moment for us to come together, stand up, and fight back.** This is our chance to finally end the filibuster, protect reproductive freedom + our democracy, and expand our Democratic majority.
**[So what do you say? Will you rush a $5 donation to the Flippable Five Fund today? Your donation will be evenly split between all five of our campaigns.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-2?refcode=em20221012-7682&refcode2=7682_434096_lhcpFd&akid=7682%2E434096%2ElhcpFd)**
Thank you so much. 🙏
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221012-7682-footer&t=1&refcode2=7682_434096_lhcpFd&akid=7682%2E434096%2ElhcpFd)**

subject: REMINDER –Today at 4p ET / 1p PT – Speaker Pelosi’s Grassroots Volunteer Update with DCCC Chair Sean Patrick Maloney
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
With our economy, our Democracy and our freedoms on the line, we must hold our Democratic House!
Join our Grassroots Update as DCCC Chair Maloney and I lay out our PATH TO VICTORY and how YOU
can help!

Join us TODAY 4pm ET / 1pm PT:
https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_Hi7GYH9RTl-cdAcD9bOkAQ

Dear Friends,

With your help, Democrats have governed For The People by growing our economy with record jobs numbers, lower health costs, unprecedented investments in our infrastructure and future – with minimal to no help from Republicans.

Less than 4 weeks to November 8th, Democrats are on a path to victory that ran from Kansas to New York to Alaska and across our nation.
On Wednesday, join me and my Special Guest, DCCC Chair Sean Patrick Maloney to talk about DEMOCRATS’ PLAN TO WIN: GROWING OUR ECONOMY, DEFENDING OUR FREEDOMS.

RSVP here for our Zoom on Wednesday, October 12th at 1pm PT / 4pm ET (**note the special time**):

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_Hi7GYH9RTl-cdAcD9bOkAQ

Chairman Maloney is a leader in the Congress and on our national battlefield. Representing New York’s Hudson Valley, Chairman Maloney knows first-hand what it takes to win a tough race in a competitive district.

He brings that battle-tested perspective and a plan to keep our Democratic House Majority.

In the House, Rep. Maloney serves on the Intelligence, Agriculture, and Transportation & Infrastructure Committees. He never stops fighting and delivering for Hudson Valley working families like the one he grew up in and the one he has built with his husband Randy and their three children. As the first openly gay Congressman from New York, Congressman Maloney knows how important it is to make the Equality Act the law of the land, once and for all, and to secure the rights and freedoms of all Americans.

# A Message from Victoria Spartz
It’s hard to believe, but we’re only 27 Days away from the election in November. Early voting starts today, and our campaign is running at full speed. Over the past weeks and months, I’ve had the opportunity to speak with many of you throughout our communities. I’m grateful to those I’ve met along the campaign trail right here at home in Indiana. And when I’m not spending time with fellow Hoosiers, I’m fighting for you in Washington. The radical Biden-Pelosi Democrats are simply out of control, and we must continue fighting to ensure the very freedoms we enjoy are not stripped away from underneath us. That is why this upcoming election is so important. We must keep the 5th District seat red, and we must win in competitive districts across our nation to take back the House and our country. Thank you for being part of our team, and joining us in the fight.
|
---
From Hamilton County to Delaware County and all parts in between, Team Spartz had a busy summer attending events and meeting constituents all throughout the 5th District.
One of the best parts of the campaign trail is joining folks at our local fairs and festivals. It’s a great opportunity to speak directly with Hoosiers and hear what’s on their minds.
It was truly an honor to attend the inaugural Northern Hamilton County GOP meeting. I began my career in public service as a grassroots volunteer in Hamilton County, and I know how vitally important our local efforts are. I’m so grateful to those who dedicate their time and energy to our Republican cause!
It was a great turnout as always at the annual Lincoln Lawn Party in Boone County. Republicans are energized and ready to win races up and down the ballot this November!
|
---
# Endorsements
As I run for re-election, I am honored and humbled with the outpouring of support from constituents and organizations. Recently, I was proud to accept the endorsements of three groups which represent thousands of Hoosiers in the 5th District and across our great state.
I am proud to stand with **National Right to Life** , and am grateful for their endorsement. I understand how precious the American Dream is, and I will continue advocating for every child to have the chance to live and pursue that dream.
As a businesswoman and someone who knows what it takes to get a small business off the ground, it means so much to me to have the endorsement of the **National Federation of Independent Businesses**. Now more than ever before, businesses are penalized for success. We must once again allow businesses to thrive without burdensome regulation and crippling taxation.
From out of control inflation, to supply chain disruptions and pain at the pump, our farmers are paying the price. As a farmer myself, I know what farming families are facing, and I will always have their backs. I’m honored to have earned the endorsement of **Indiana Farm Bureau AgELECT** , and I will not let our farmers down.
|
---
# Opportunities to Help
The upcoming November election is incredibly important. We cannot take anything for granted, and we must reach every voter in the 5th District to spread our message and uphold our values of limited government and individual freedoms. We are fighting the radical left on every front, and we must win to preserve our way of life. Can we count on you to sign up and volunteer for our campaign? You can do so on our website [here](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=1875fe2311&e=57d5bacdc3). A member of our team will be in touch.
| [SIGN UP HERE](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=7fc470f50b&e=57d5bacdc3)
---
You can also sign up to [host a yard sign](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=16ab6fd5af&e=57d5bacdc3). Simply provide your information, and we can get you sign pickup information, or have a sign delivered to you!
| [REQUEST A SIGN](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=5fe2b49c2a&e=57d5bacdc3)
---
This a pivotal election in our nation’s history, and we must have the resources to fight back and retake the House. As Victoria fights for us, will you stand with her? [Click here](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=80f6d921ec&e=57d5bacdc3) to send $10, $25, $50, or any amount you can today. Your rush donation will fuel our efforts and make sure we send Victoria back to Washington to fight for us.
| [DONATE TODAY](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=1fb536e820&e=57d5bacdc3)

Victoria is the qualified, proven conservative we need. God bless. -Team Spartz

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: My opponent released a poll showing him UP ONE POINT. | | Fellow American, I know I’ve reached out to you a few times about this... My opponent released an internal poll showing him UP ONE POINT. This poll might’ve been conducted by a Democrat firm who worked for Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden – but we can’t take anything for granted. This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he’s leading. Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. | | Friend, As Chairman of the Kendall County Board, I have made it a priority to keep taxes in check while providing top-notch services. This common-sense approach has kept law enforcement funded and made Kendall County one of the best places to live, work, and raise a family in the country. Unfortunately, Congress has a different view. Currently in Washington, they see common-sense leadership as the problem. I see it as the solution. Higher inflation, higher gas prices, and higher energy bills have hit Illinois families hard. Unfortunately, Lauren Underwood continually pushed the Green New Deal and costly tax hikes at the expense of hardworking Americans. I believe we deserve better. We need a Congressperson who is looking to cut taxes, not hike them; to lower energy bills, not raise them. I will stop the "consumer last" mentality and bring the lower taxes, better government approach I have taken in Kendall County to Congress. But I need your help to get there! With all the daily news coverage about the ups and downs of politics — which candidate leads in the polls, which candidate just tweeted something controversial, etc. — it’s easy to lose sight of what campaigns are really about.
So I wanted to take a minute to talk about what’s at stake in this race, because this election matters a whole lot.
**It matters whether or not we defeat an anti-abortion Republican in this district and prevent election deniers from taking control of Congress.**
**It matters whether or not we have enough votes in the House to fight climate change, defend voting rights, and codify the right to choose.**
**It matters whether or not we help the regular families who are struggling amid rising costs — and take real action to make health care, housing, and child care more affordable.**
Folks, if I have the honor of representing Colorado’s 7th District in Congress, I promise you this: I will work my heart out to help out the regular families who are struggling right now, defend the civil rights that Republicans are attacking, and stop gun violence from claiming more innocent lives.
**_That_ is what is on the line in this race — the future of our communities, our civil rights, and our democracy. If you are with me in this fight, I’d be honored if you could pitch in and support me.**

subject: I fled Communism, fought for our country, and now I’m running for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emmer for Congress
body:
| |
---
| | | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617535:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r)
---

Peter , my name is Hung Cao. I'm an immigrant, a graduate of the Naval Academy, a 25-year combat veteran of Afghanistan, Iraq, and Somalia, and a true Conservative running to FLIP Virginia's 10th District.

_**[I'd love your support, and for a Conservative challenger fighting to take down a lifelong Democrat politician, any donation means the world to me and my campaign.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617536:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r "I’d love your support, and for a Conservative challenger fighting to take down a lifelong Democrat
politician, any donation means the world to me and my campaign.")**_

But first, let me tell you my story:

I was born in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. After the fall of Saigon, Vietnamese Communists put my father's name on an execution list, and my family was forced to flee to the United States.

**As a family, we quickly realized that coming to America was the best thing that could have happened to us.**

As a child, I was so moved by the life the United States had afforded my family that I swore I would serve my country at any cost. I returned from my last combat deployment to Afghanistan in January of 2021.

As I settled into civilian life, I noticed how much damage our current government was doing to the people of my community. Out-of-control spending worsening inflation, tax increases during a recession, illiberal COVID lockdowns and mandates, and the indoctrination of our children in federally funded schools. Seeing leaders in Washington use their power to promote personal agendas at the expense of the American people, my family, my friends, and my community -- it was all almost too much to bear.

The dream that my family was able to achieve over four decades ago was dying, and I decided I needed to do something about it: I decided to run for Congress -- _**[to preserve the American dream for ALL Americans.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617535:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r "to preserve the American dream for ALL Americans.")**_
---

---
| | [JOIN MY FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617536:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r)
---
| | [SUPPORT CONSERVATIVE IMMIGRANTS](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617536:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r)
---
| | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61617536:Jw1hQUVxN:m:1:3317145305:374FF24884F5AE83C7F9E317E2D50663:r)
---

_**No one loves America like I do.**_ I know what it looks like to see your country fall apart. I know what it feels like to have your rights taken from you. I know what it takes to make things right. My fellow Conservative immigrants and I won't let what happened to our countries happen here. We will serve our adopted home proudly, and we will serve you -- no exceptions.

Thank you for everything you do,

Hung Cao (R-VA)

| _**Regan Deering for Congress**_
---
| | |
---
| **Friends,**
**I am honored to be endorsed by the Fraternal Order of the Police, but more importantly, I am grateful for their service. ** **In order to protect and serve our community, law enforcement needs support from our elected officials.** ** ** **The “Defund the Police” movement and policies supported by my opponent have helped hollow out police departments across our state with officers leaving the profession in record numbers.** ** ** **Our law enforcement is working overtime \- being away from their families to protect ours. ** ** ** **They are working overtime running toward trouble, so we can run away from it. ** ** ** **They are working overtime to help bring peace and justice for all.** ** ** **Supporting the police can’t just be lip service or political ads for our elected officials.** ** ** **That support comes in many ways, including funding, training, and coordination.** ** ** **We need elected officials who understand their value, risk and dedication.** ** ** **Supporting the police means voting for laws to help them and against laws to hurt them. ** ** ** **It also means ensuring that they don’t just have a seat at the table - but influence in the outcome of the discussion. ** ** ** **Two years ago my opponent helped pass criminal justice reform that was opposed by nearly every law enforcement group in the state. ** ** ** **That doesn’t sound like justice to me. ** ** ** **I will listen to these experts when they give me their opinions, and use their counsel to make my decisions. ** ** ** **I will vote to refund their departments instead of for massive unfunded mandates that burden them with costs and regulations. ** ** ** **I will vote for policies to help them secure our schools to ensure that they can more safely and efficiently protect our children in cases of emergency.** ** ** **I will help protect their qualified immunity so they can continue to save lives and livelihoods. ** ** ** **Most of all, I will vote for policies that help handcuff criminals - not the police. ** ** ** **I want you all to know that you don’t just have my votes - you also have my voice. ** ** ** **As your Congresswoman, I will fight against the anti-police narrative that is currently being told here in Illinois and around the country. ** ** ** **I am endorsed because these brave officers see potential and commitment in me to be that representative - their representative.** ** ** **Thank you to the ILFOP for standing with me and please know that I will ALWAYS stand with our law enforcement officers.**

Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.
I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.
Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator.

I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you.
Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio _every single quarter _and make this race competitive _. _But we're in danger of falling short of our FINAL FEC quarterly fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap.

If I'm honest, I'm worried that missing this goal means losing our momentum to flip Florida blue – because I'm already being outspent in key areas of the state and the latest polling has us slipping.
**So please – to help me close the 1-point gap in the polls and defeat my anti-choice, pro-Trump opponent, Marco Rubio – will you split a $15 donation between my campaign and American Bridge PAC for Senate now? Val Demings

This means that the ad a voter sees today could be the last message they see before voting. That’s why Republicans’ last-minute barrage of attack ads aimed at our candidates up and down the ballot is concerning. We need to make sure the last message voters hear before they vote is about how our candidates will lead us to a better Arizona, and how extreme the AZ GOP is from top to bottom. Arizona voters are making their decisions right now. That’s why we have to respond immediately – we can’t wait until November to change their minds. More than 85% of Arizonans vote early and by mail. name: Jamal Raad, Evergreen Action
subject: 📈 Guess how fast we expanded the grid this decade?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
Help us tell FERC it's unacceptable.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/FERC-get-grid-ready-comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&t=2&akid=13106%2E53494%2EVqiYsJ) | _Today's action is part of Evergreen's**100% Clean Power Campaign**. Together, we're mobilizing support for policies that will rapidly accelerate a just transition to a clean energy future.
Interested? [_**Act today to stay in the loop!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/FERC-get-grid-ready-comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&t=3&akid=13106%2E53494%2EVqiYsJ)_
---
Friend,
Guess how fast the electrical grid in the U.S. has expanded in the last decade? Only about one percent per year.
The Inflation Reduction Act will cut climate pollution and put the U.S. within striking distance of its climate goals. But if we don't pick up the pace of that grid expansion, we'll lose up to 80 percent of that pollution reduction potential.
**To put it simply: The clean energy transition won't happen fast enough at the scale we need if we don't hurry up and expand the grid.**
Right now, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) is accepting public comments about the future of our power grid. We need to tell them that our clean energy future depends on rapid expansion of high-voltage capacity—but we only have until tomorrow.
[_**Sign an official public comment right now and we'll send it directly to FERC—there's too much at risk to sit this one out.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/FERC-get-grid-ready-comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&t=4&akid=13106%2E53494%2EVqiYsJ)
[SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/FERC-get-grid-ready-comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&t=5&akid=13106%2E53494%2EVqiYsJ)
---
New analysis reveals that we need to expand high-voltage capacity by an average of 2.3 percent per year to fulfill the Inflation Reduction Act's potential.
Here's why: As more solar panels and windmills get built, we need to move that energy from the sunniest and windiest places to everywhere else. Right now, we simply can't.
A lot of people sat back and put their feet up after we passed the Inflation Reduction Act. But folks like you know that these wonky details will make or break our clean energy future. That's why I'm calling on you before FERC's final deadline tomorrow:
[_**We need everyone who gives a FERC about clean energy to send a public comment right now.**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/FERC-get-grid-ready-comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&source=ema_2022-10-12_FERC_deadline_comment_&t=6&akid=13106%2E53494%2EVqiYsJ)
Jamal Raad
Executive Director, Evergreen Action

| | Friend,**

** Over the past week, we’ve been on a 27-stop Kansas GOP bus tour all across our great state. Derek got to speak to each one of you directly to share his vision and his plan for Kansas. [On our final stop](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=d607c82c7f764185adffbe6c291267da&_e=JIjjaXqb4iIuT1VA5GUyyZNdXf8zPgoOL2Mm4CT6-ObWyG166YkAKX3YIHOOx0f22Vi3PHpxEu5QrifC0fa9uCCCStU5nLbZA7n5VvIjD3wnKNVByQA4ajzS5y5aE0JfN1trOm4_dMKvIjkrs4dGxENa_bKuxF7Wpq_cSTuOqggC7GnRla8io9mvRVSNqJedK6QclyNJcfBKhXN1xbYNYPkQerTm_PWzJFSlzNFjZbI%3D), we heard encouraging words from our friend Senator Roger Marshall: _“Derek Schmidt and I share the same values. We’ve seen government get in the way of Kansans' ability to protect their children, support law enforcement, and support our economy.

body:
Now, it’s my turn to help Mark.
#

Friend —
11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
With a lot of practice, I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, and making me laugh. Now, it’s my turn to help him.
I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close.
Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. And on top of that, early voting begins TODAY in Arizona. So, I’m asking:
[**Can you chip in $3 – or anything you can afford – to Mark’s re-election campaign? Now, it’s my turn to help him. I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close. Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. And on top of that, early voting begins TODAY in Arizona.
