You’ve yet to make a donation this year, so I’m asking: Will you split a $10 donation between my campaign + the DNC today? Back in August, this same election watcher rated our race “Lean Democrat.” That means that over just the last few weeks, Dr. Oz + his far-right buddies supporting his campaign have spent enough to move the needle back in their direction. 😮 And you can bet they’ll continue spending whatever it takes to try to overpower our campaign. We can’t let that happen. This race is getting tighter by the day, and with less than a month until Election Day, we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas. Our ability to flip this seat from Red 🔴 to Blue 🔵 + defeat Dr. Oz will come down to the strength behind our grassroots movement. Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The polls all show this will be a very close race, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky
against Rand Paul.

I’m running for Senate because Rand Paul has turned his back on the
Veterans he purports to care about. One of them is John, a U.S. Marine
Veteran, and hero who sacrificed for our country.

John was drafted as a teenager and was stationed in Camp Lejeune, where he
was exposed to toxic water contamination. Years later, he’s been diagnosed
with Hairy Cell Leukemia.

John shouldn’t have to spend the rest of his life wondering how he’ll
afford medical treatment. But Rand Paul turned his back on our Veterans
when he opposed the bipartisan PACT Act, which provides health care to
Vets like John.

Our Vets deserve a Senator who will fight for them, not turn their back.
That’s what I’ll be if I’m elected this November. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18745?t=1001&akid=2592%2E346206%2Ez81mnD ]But I need your help
to win. Can you pitch in $20 or more to send me to the U.S. Senate and
DEFEAT Rand Paul?

CONTRIBUTE →

No person who turns their back on our Vets should be in the Senate. Let’s send
him packing.

Thank you,

Charles Booker

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, it's time for early voting! Now through November 7th, make your plan to write in Haneefah Khaaliq today. You may also write in Haneefah, Khaaliq, or H.K. I appreciate your vote! Election day is November 8, 2022.

But that's not all.

I want a chance to personally meet you! On Sunday, October 23rd, October 30th, and November 6th, at 7 p.m. EST, I'll be hosting virtual meet & greet sessions just for you! Choose one now:

[RSVP Sunday, October 23, 2022, 7 p.m. EST](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=4757c234a0&e=a49cb82bb3)

Bring your questions, concerns, and get ready to spend a little time with me right before the midterm elections! Share. Tell a friend. Register now! Space is limited. See you soon!

* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

Hi team -- It's Diana, the DSCC’s Research Director.

Having up-to-date and accurate data is **_essential_** at this point in the campaign ‐‐ and right now, one of the biggest questions my team gets asked is: _How is early voting going?_

**That's why I'm reaching out to _you._** Our Chief Digital Officer, Kati, said you're an engaged and dedicated Democrat I can count on, so I really need your help.

**Please, will you accept my invitation to join our Official Early Voting Focus Group?[To ensure your responses are reviewed by our team, I recommend you join immediately >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/10330?ask=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20221012-Diana-EarlyVotingFocusGroupRF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20221012-Diana-EarlyVotingFocusGroupRF-Pros-sl1&akid=7578%2E9716520%2EaFMuiA)**

Early voting is active in over 15 states already, and mail ballots are being sent out across the country -- despite the GOP's best efforts to suppress our voting rights. **But we need to hear from YOU about how it's going on the ground in Pennsylvania.**

Your responses will be seen by top Democratic Party leaders as we make final decisions about early voting and where to allocate resources in the last 27 days.

Please, there's no time to waste. If you're voting in this election -- or if you've already voted (thank you!) -- join our Early Voting Focus Group _immediately_ : **[www.dscc.org/2022-Early-Voting-Focus-Group#9716520](https://go.dscc.org/go/10330?ask=5&t=9&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20221012-Diana-EarlyVotingFocusGroupRF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20221012-Diana-EarlyVotingFocusGroupRF-Pros-sl1&akid=7578%2E9716520%2EaFMuiA)**

body:
Black Americans AREN'T the Democrat Party's SLAVES! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/471fa7b49aee/we-need-more-veterans-in-the-house-do-you-agree-15922209?e=3cd8121505)
---
| |
---
| |
#
**My Fellow Patriot,**
**All my life, I was told that because of the color of my skin, we HAD to be Democrats. Blind in my youth, I listened UNTIL I joined the Navy and proudly served this country. I found the meaning of being a patriotic American, and I understood that the GOP was the party defending our nation’s values, NOT the Democrats.

I worked with President Trump to EXPOSE the Left’s narrative and expel the racist hold they had on our community. Here are the facts. Black Americans are FLEEING the Democrat party in droves!

I LEFT the Democrat Plantation because I REFUSED TO BE THEIR SLAVE! I am FREE!

I led the charge in 2016, and I’m not stopping now. Not only was I pastor of my church here in Richmond, Virginia, but I was the GOP Chairman for my area. I ran, I fought, and I won. Now I’m running for VA-4 as the GOP Nominee! ** [**HELP ME LIBERATE THE BLACK COMMUNITY!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=b1c266a2d1&e=3cd8121505) .**My name is Leon Benjamin, and I’m running for Congress as a Conservative Republican... because I’m sick of what the far Left has done to my community and to American families. I’m a husband, father, and pastor. I owe it to my congregation and my family to build a better future. These days we need to fight for them even to have a future!** [**Help me beat the special interests and the Soros money, and support our list of endorsed candidates- $50, $150, $250!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=20e0d84fdd&e=3cd8121505)
**I’m a Navy Combat Veteran, Small Business Owner, and Senior Pastor and Bishop at my church. I even helped create President Trump’s Faith-Based Initiative back in 2016.

I’m up against a proxy-voting DC sellout who sells out Christianity and the black community at every SECOND! My opponent VOTED FOR inflation! VOTED FOR the border crisis! VOTED FOR more crime! VOTED FOR election overhaul! Unlike him, I WILL SERVE MY COMMUNITY!**

[**SUPPORT BLACK CONSERVATIVE CANDIDATES!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=9b95c93637&e=3cd8121505) **If the Left really cared about the Black community, as President Trump does, then we would have seen greater action decades ago as we saw in the last administration. It’s time the Left learned that conservative principles and conservative values ARE BLACK VALUES.

BLM and Antifa are more focused on destroying our communities and burning them down than fighting issues affecting us like inflation, high gas prices, or higher consumer prices. They are hateful, destructive, and out of touch. **
[**DONATE TO TAKE BACK THE HOUSE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=81236d1908&e=3cd8121505)
**My opponent is a radical leftist who’s voted to strip law-abiding Americans, voted for the election overthrow HR-1, gun control, socialism, mass amnesty, and so much more. His actions to trample our constitution, destroy American values and suppress We The People’s voice is unacceptable.

I appreciate your support; my team said I need to come up with $15,000 by the end of this month to help secure our media and radio slots to win the general. **
**[DONATE NOW!](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=31584b8257&e=3cd8121505)**

**[$25](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=bfb95a1350&e=3cd8121505)**

**[$50](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4f845c42ba&e=3cd8121505)**

**[$75](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=7aea644caa&e=3cd8121505)**

[**$100**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=1f20db4852&e=3cd8121505)
**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=618b5ca4f5&e=3cd8121505)

And while sadly, my beloved Detroit Tigers did not make the postseason this year, baseball is still on my mind. That’s because we’re in the 9th inning of this campaign season, and with just three outs to go, we need to do everything in our power to close out Karamo.
Now, I’m the manager of this final inning, and the best thing a manager can do is have clear communication with the rest of the team. So here’s my plan to get these final three outs and re-elect Jocelyn to secretary of state.
Keep running great ads across the state to spread Jocelyn’s message and ensure that Michiganders know about all the outstanding work Jocelyn has done these past four years. Help the campaign keep our ads running. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/realresults-benson?refcode=101222]

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
| OMG.

**Dr. Oz had a horrible week.** From exposes about his career hawking scam medical treatments on TV + experiments that killed *hundreds* of dogs, to being pictured speaking in front of Hitler's car at a GOP fundraiser.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: My thoughts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We heard racism and bigotry from some of Los Angeles’ most powerful leaders, but that’s not all.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221012-3491-header&t=1&akid=3491%2E2526796%2EyJvQJG)
In a recording leaked this week, we heard racism and bigotry from some of Los Angeles’ most powerful leaders.1 We also heard them stoking a divide between the city’s communities.
**First, I want to say that the comments that were made are simply incompatible with holding elected office.** It violates the public trust. Point blank. That’s the beginning and the end of it.
**But I also want to dig a little bit deeper into the psychology of these comments. Because it’s just as bad, if not worse.**
In corrupt, racist, and classist environments or political situations, people in power rely on pitting communities against each other — whether it’s racially, geographically, or otherwise.
**They rely on trying to get Black, Latino, Asian, Native, white, rural, and urban communities to see each other as enemies.**
Leaders who fall for this are not equipped to lead. This scarcity mentality — that we need to be suspicious of other ethnic groups or of other types of interest groups — comes from the top.
Because the more these “leaders” can stoke fighting amongst ourselves, the more they can keep us from building solidarity with each other. This is dangerous.
People in power rely on dividing us to ensure that nothing changes. This is not unique to Los Angeles — we experience it in New York. One of the reasons I hated electoral politics was because I got sick of people claiming they represented me or where I’m from only to get caught betraying our community.
**We need to be able to trust each other and stick together. If we don’t trust each other, we’re not able to build solidarity with each other.**
Thank you for reading.
Alexandria

A new poll has me down by 1 in the Georgia Senate race with less than 4 weeks until the election.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After decades of stagnant wages and over two years of a debilitating
pandemic, most workers are far from the living wages everyone deserves.
It’s clear to us that high wages, high employment, and high union
representation will transform life for working people – and that’s exactly
